item.title: Version 0.34
item.description:
New: Review external edits without blocking your flow. When a file changes on disk, markjason now loads the latest version immediately and keeps a subtle review notice.

Improved: External file changes are treated as forward progress. You can inspect the diff, revert changes, or keep changes while editing and autosave continue normally.

Fixed: The external-edit banner no longer flashes and disappears immediately after reload.

If the installer fails, please download the latest version manually from markjason.sh
